While it shows 5-year median spreads rather than the exact Baa-10yr Treasury spread, it offers insight into the general behavior and trends of investment-grade corporate bond spreads, including Baa, which are influenced by market conditions and credit risk perceptions.

evidence.title: Treasuries Hold Steady; Markets Currently Price 150bp in Fed Cuts
evidence.summary: This article, published at the end of 2023, discusses market expectations for Fed rate cuts in 2024 and mentions IG CDS spreads at 56bp. While not directly the Baa-10yr spread, the expectation of Fed rate cuts can influence Treasury yields and corporate bond yields, thus impacting the spread. Lower interest rates generally support corporate credit, potentially tightening spreads.
